title: Section 106 BSA — Burden of proving fact especially within knowledge

content.heading: Burden of proving fact especially within knowledge
content.text: When any fact is especially within the knowledge of any person, the burden of proving that fact is upon him. This is the current analogue of the historical Evidence Act, 1872 section 106. Read the official BSA text. It does not replace the prosecution's primary burden in a criminal trial.
